local:rumdl-tags-are-annotated.title: rumdl publishes ANNOTATED tags, so `git ls-remote --tags --refs` returns the TAG OBJECT and not the commit — `v0.2.60` is `510d056a` as a tag and `50dbfef7` as a commit, and only the latter belongs in the manifest. Verified by control arm at the 0.2.58 -> 0.2.60 bump: `v0.2.58^{}` resolves to `023027472dbcb502aeb89760f4122e2235d36490`, which is exactly what the manifest already held, so the probe discriminates rather than merely agreeing. This is the THIRD repo tracked here with annotated tags (agnix and rumdl yes; fnox and hk lightweight), which is why the peeled form must be read every time rather than assumed per-repo.
